limitations: The first endpoint is not forced to equal HCl exactly.
Refilling the burette does not reset material history.
Indicator persistence and optical mixtures require independent data.
steps: During Native setup, prepare supported HCl in the primary bottle and an acetic-acid reserve. Document both choices.
Prime the graduated burette from represented stock, or dispense a measured bottle aliquot into the receiver.
Use Native pipette source switching and controlled delivery for the second stock; record every accepted receipt.
Inspect the receiver pH support, revision and freshness; add branch-linked notebook observations, then Save and Review.
